title_zh: 索取社团服装的批量报价

scenario.label_zh: 索取社团服装批量报价
scenario.goal_zh: 选定待报价的服装款式和数量，并明确先获取含印字费用的报价而不下单

context_zh: 跑步社团负责人向服装供应商询价。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I'm looking at the club apparel in your catalog. Can you quote for thirty of the blue training shirts?

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: Certainly. Do you want plain shirts or your club name printed on them?

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: The name on the front, please. Is there a discount if we order in bulk?

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: Thirty qualifies for our group price. I'll include that and the printing charge in the quote.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Thanks. Please send the full price before we decide. This isn't an order yet.

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: Understood. I'll email a quote for thirty printed blue shirts, with no order placed.
